data.name: SARA
data.detailed_description:
SARA is a psychological horror game set during a series of late-night shifts inside a forgotten facility.

Complete your assigned tasks, monitor security systems, investigate strange occurrences, and uncover the truth hidden within the building's walls. As the nights progress, disturbing events begin to unfold and long-buried secrets start to surface.

Search for clues during your breaks, piece together the facility's dark history, and discover what really happened to Sara.

Will you survive all five nights?

Features

  • Five nights of psychological horror

  • Atmospheric analogue horror inspired by late 1990s horror games

  • Story-driven mystery revealed through clues and documents

  • Multiple paranormal encounters and jump scares

  • Interactive workplace tasks and CCTV monitoring

  • Hidden lore to uncover throughout the game

  • Single-player experience

Investigate the Truth

What began as a routine night shift quickly becomes something far more disturbing.

Strange figures appear where they shouldn't.

Documents reveal a history that was never meant to be discovered.

And somewhere within the facility, Sara is still waiting.

Mature Content Description

This game contains psychological horror, jump scares, unsettling imagery, and references to death and human experimentation. No graphic violence, gore, nudity, sexual content, or strong language is depicted.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 850 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended. Full-screen play recommended for the intended experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card or modern integrated graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 999 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended. Full-screen play recommended for the intended experience.

content_descriptors.notes: SARA is a psychological horror game that contains jump scares, unsettling imagery, tense atmosphere, and disturbing themes. The story includes references to human experimentation, death, and institutional cover-ups presented through documents, clues, and environmental storytelling. The game does not contain graphic violence, gore, nudity, sexual content, drug use, or strong language.
